instruction: Candid full shot of an indoor martial arts gym with gray padded walls. On the right, the man in the black athletic shirt (R1) stands with his back mostly to the camera in a defensive stance. On the left, the man in the gray t-shirt (R2) balances on one leg, executing a kick toward him. In the background, a bystander in a red tank top stands watching. The scene is captured with even overhead lighting and a neutral color palette.
